A female cartoon avatar overlay is visible in the bottom left corner. The man is speaking and gesturing with his hands. (2) A wide aerial shot shows a large body of blue water filled with numerous small wooden boats, some with white and blue sails. The water is calm with gentle ripples. (3) Returning to the bar studio, the man continues his explanation, using expansive hand gestures. The lighting is warm and focused on him. (4) A scenic shot of a wide river or bay at dawn or dusk is shown. The sky is cloudy with a golden glow reflecting off the moving water. The shoreline is visible in the distance with low-lying land. (5) A group of people dressed in traditional indigenous clothing (white shirts and blue sashes) are seen dancing in a large circle outdoors at night, their backs to the camera. (6) Back in the studio, the man gestures with both hands as if holding a large object. The background remains consistent with the bar setting and neon sign. (7) A digital map of Taipei's Da'an District is overlaid on the screen, showing various road names and a yellow highlighted area. (8) The man in the bar poses with a determined look, holding a fist up towards his chest. (9) An aerial view of lush green farmland and rice paddies is shown. The fields are divided into rectangular plots with some scattered trees and buildings in the background. (10) The man continues speaking in the studio, using hand motions to illustrate his points until the video ends.
